```{r}
# STEP 0 - Setup Helper

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Output folder structure (project root/output)
root_out <- "../output"

dir_datainspect <- file.path(root_out, "datainspection")
dir_desc        <- file.path(root_out, "descriptive")
dir_desc_y      <- file.path(dir_desc, "Y_variables")
dir_desc_x      <- file.path(dir_desc, "X_variables")
dir_desc_xy     <- file.path(dir_desc, "XY_correlation")

dirs <- c(dir_datainspect, dir_desc, dir_desc_y, dir_desc_x, dir_desc_xy)
for (d in dirs) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Helper: safe filename
safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)

# Helper: save numeric hist + boxplot
save_numeric_plots <- function(df, var, out_dir, bins = 30) {
  v <- df[[var]]
  if (!is.numeric(v)) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  # Histogram
  p_hist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_histogram(bins = bins) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Distribution:", var), x = var, y = "Count")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("dist_", safe_name(var), ".png")),
    plot = p_hist, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150
  )
  
  # Boxplot
  p_box <- ggplot(df, aes(y = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Outliers:", var), y = var, x = "")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("box_", safe_name(var), ".png")),
    plot = p_box, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 150
  )
}

# Helper: save categorical bar plot
save_categorical_plot <- function(df, var, out_dir, top_n = 30) {
  v <- df[[var]]
  if (!(is.character(v) || is.factor(v))) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    mutate(.x = as.character(.data[[var]])) %>%
    count(.x, sort = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  p_bar <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x = reorder(.x, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Counts:", var, "(Top", top_n, ")"),
      x = var,
      y = "Count"
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("bar_", safe_name(var), ".png")),
    plot = p_bar, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 150
  )
}

# Helper: save relationship plots (Y vs X)
save_y_relationship_plots <- function(df, y, x, out_dir) {
  # numeric X -> scatter + smooth
  if (is.numeric(df[[x]])) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
      geom_smooth(se = TRUE) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste(y, "vs", x), x = x, y = y)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("y_vs_", safe_name(x), ".png")),
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150
    )
  }
  
  # categorical X -> boxplot of Y by X
  if (is.character(df[[x]]) || is.factor(df[[x]])) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(.data[[x]]), y = .data[[y]])) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste(y, "by", x), x = x, y = y)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("y_by_", safe_name(x), "_box.png")),
      plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150
    )
  }
}

# Helper: Overdispersion visuals (mean-variance + long-tail hist)
save_overdispersion_visuals <- function(df, y, out_dir) {
  if (!is.numeric(df[[y]])) return(invisible(NULL))

  yv <- df[[y]]
  yv <- yv[is.finite(yv)]

  mu  <- mean(yv, na.rm = TRUE)
  va  <- var(yv, na.rm = TRUE)
  disp_ratio <- ifelse(mu > 0, va / mu, NA_real_)

  # Mean vs Variance bar plot
  mv_df <- data.frame(
    metric = c("Mean", "Variance"),
    value  = c(mu, va)
  )

  p_mv <- ggplot(mv_df, aes(x = metric, y = value)) +
    geom_col() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Mean vs Variance: ", y),
      subtitle = paste0("Variance / Mean = ", round(disp_ratio, 2),
                        " (>>1 suggests overdispersion)"),
      x = "", y = ""
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("mean_variance_", safe_name(y), ".png")),
    plot = p_mv, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 150
  )

  # Long-tail histogram (raw)
  p_hist_raw <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Long-tail Histogram (Raw):", y), x = y, y = "Count")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("hist_longtail_raw_", safe_name(y), ".png")),
    plot = p_hist_raw, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150
  )

  # Long-tail histogram (log1p) — makes tail readable
  df2 <- df %>% mutate(.y_log1p = log1p(.data[[y]]))

  p_hist_log <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = .data[[".y_log1p"]])) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Long-tail Histogram (log1p):", y),
         x = paste0("log1p(", y, ")"), y = "Count")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("hist_longtail_log1p_", safe_name(y), ".png")),
    plot = p_hist_log, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150
  )

  invisible(list(mean = mu, variance = va, var_over_mean = disp_ratio))
}

```

```{r}
# STEP 1 - Clean Data Loading 

# 1.1 Load
df_clean <- read.csv("../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# STEP 2 - Correlation Heatmap

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# 2.1 Select numeric variables but remove identifiers
numeric_df <- df_clean %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-id, -host_id)

# 2.2 Compute correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_df, use = "complete.obs")

# 2.3 Convert matrix to long format
cor_long <- melt(cor_matrix)

# 2.4 Plot heatmap
p_cor <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Heatmap (Numeric Variables)",
    x = "", y = "", fill = "Correlation"
  )

p_cor

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(dir_desc, "correlation_heatmap_numeric.png"),
  plot = p_cor,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r}
# STEP 3 - Descriptive Analysis

# Save printed outputs to text file (descriptive folder)
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()
sink(file.path(dir_desc, "Descriptive_Analysis_Summary.txt"))

cat("====================================\n")
cat("DESCRIPTIVE ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Inspect Y (number_of_reviews)
# -------------------------------------------------

cat("3.1 Y = number_of_reviews\n")
cat("Mean:", mean(df_clean$number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median:", median(df_clean$number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Variance:", var(df_clean$number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Min:", min(df_clean$number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Max:", max(df_clean$number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Missing:", sum(is.na(df_clean$number_of_reviews)), "\n")
cat("Zero count:", sum(df_clean$number_of_reviews == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# Plots for Y
save_numeric_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", out_dir = dir_desc_y)

# EXTRA VISUAL EVIDENCE: Overdispersion + long tail
ov <- save_overdispersion_visuals(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", out_dir = dir_desc_y)

cat("Overdispersion check (visuals saved):\n")
cat("Variance/Mean ratio:", ov$var_over_mean, "\n\n")

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.2 Inspect Independent Variables (X)
# -------------------------------------------------

cat("------------------------------------\n")
cat("3.2 Variable Classes\n")
print(sapply(df_clean, class))
cat("\n")

# Numeric variables: summaries + plots
numeric_vars <- df_clean[, sapply(df_clean, is.numeric), drop = FALSE]

cat("------------------------------------\n")
cat("3.2A Numeric Variables: summary + plots saved\n\n")

for (col in names(numeric_vars)) {
  cat("Numeric:", col, "\n")
  print(summary(numeric_vars[[col]]))
  cat("\n")
  save_numeric_plots(df_clean, col, out_dir = dir_desc_x)
}

# Categorical variables: cardinality + bar plots
categorical_vars <- df_clean[, sapply(df_clean, function(x) is.character(x) || is.factor(x)), drop = FALSE]

cat("------------------------------------\n")
cat("3.2B Categorical Variables: cardinality + bar plots saved\n\n")

for (col in names(categorical_vars)) {
  cat("Categorical:", col, "\n")
  cat("Cardinality:", length(unique(df_clean[[col]])), "\n\n")
  save_categorical_plot(df_clean, col, out_dir = dir_desc_x, top_n = 30)
}

# Missing values (full table)
cat("------------------------------------\n")
cat("3.2C Missing Values (all columns)\n")
print(colSums(is.na(df_clean)))
cat("\n")

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.3 Relationships Between Y and X
# -------------------------------------------------

cat("------------------------------------\n")
cat("3.3 Relationships: Y vs X\n\n")

# Correlation: Y with numeric variables
correlations <- cor(numeric_vars, df_clean$number_of_reviews, use = "complete.obs")
correlations <- as.vector(correlations)
names(correlations) <- colnames(numeric_vars)

cat("Correlations with number_of_reviews (sorted):\n")
print(sort(correlations, decreasing = TRUE))
cat("\n")

# Save correlations CSV into XY folder
cor_df <- data.frame(variable = names(correlations), correlation = as.numeric(correlations))
cor_df <- cor_df[order(-cor_df$correlation), ]
write.csv(cor_df, file.path(dir_desc_xy, "y_numeric_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Group means (printed into summary file)
cat("Mean number_of_reviews by room_type:\n")
print(aggregate(number_of_reviews ~ room_type, data = df_clean, mean))
cat("\n")

# Distance bins (for grouped summaries + plots)
df_clean$distance_group <- cut(
  df_clean$distance_to_center_km,
  breaks = c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

cat("Mean number_of_reviews by distance_group:\n")
print(aggregate(number_of_reviews ~ distance_group, data = df_clean, mean))
cat("\nDistance_group counts:\n")
print(table(df_clean$distance_group))
cat("\n")

cat("Mean number_of_reviews by host_is_superhost:\n")
print(aggregate(number_of_reviews ~ host_is_superhost, data = df_clean, mean))
cat("\nSuperhost counts:\n")
print(table(df_clean$host_is_superhost))
cat("\n")

cat("Mean number_of_reviews by host_response_time_ord:\n")
print(aggregate(number_of_reviews ~ host_response_time_ord, data = df_clean, mean))
cat("\nResponse time ord counts:\n")
print(table(df_clean$host_response_time_ord))
cat("\n")

# Relationship plots saved into XY folder
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "log_price", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "amenities_count", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "distance_to_center_km", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "accommodates", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)

save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "room_type", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "host_is_superhost", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "distance_group", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)
save_y_relationship_plots(df_clean, "number_of_reviews", "host_response_time_ord", out_dir = dir_desc_xy)

cat("====================================\n")
cat("END OF DESCRIPTIVE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("Saved files:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(dir_desc, "Descriptive_Analysis_Summary.txt"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(dir_desc_y, "dist_*.png and box_*.png (Y plots)"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(dir_desc_x, "dist_*.png / box_*.png / bar_*.png (X plots)"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(dir_desc_xy, "y_vs_*.png and y_by_*_box.png (XY plots)"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(dir_desc_xy, "y_numeric_correlations.csv"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("====================================\n")

sink()

cat("Descriptive outputs + plots saved to ../output/descriptive/\n")
```
